editorialSummary.heading: Spring break continues through March 29
paragraphs: Spring break includes Monday, March 29, 2027. The district lists March 22-29 as spring break, with a separate teacher planning day on Friday, March 19. Including weekends, students are off March 19-29 and return Tuesday, March 30. After winter break, January 4 is also a teacher planning day, so classes resume January 5.

The district lists six early-dismissal dates: August 26 and October 29, 2026, and February 2, April 21, May 21 and May 27, 2027. May 27 is also the last student day. Pickup times vary by school. Mike Davis Elementary lists 11:50 a.m. for early release, and Big Cypress Elementary confirms that time for October 29. The district academic calendar does not provide one dismissal time for every school.

School Age Childcare (SACC) follows a separate operating calendar. It lists full-day care on certain teacher planning days and during the March 22-29 spring break, but families should confirm service dates and availability with their SACC site, especially for weekends. SACC programs are closed on April 21, even though students attend school and leave early. Families using SACC will need another pickup or care arrangement that day.

The district's graduation week runs May 17-21, 2027. Families should check their school's announcements for individual ceremony times and senior attendance requirements. May 21 is also an early-dismissal day, but the official calendar continues through May 27, the last student day.

faqs.question: When is the first and last day of school in Collier County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students start Tuesday, August 11, 2026, and finish Thursday, May 27, 2027. The last student day has early dismissal. May 28 is a teacher planning day, not another regular student attendance day.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official 2026-2027 Collier County school calendar?
faqs.answer: The Collier County Public Schools Academic & District Calendars page provides the approved 2026-2027 academic calendar PDF in English, Spanish and Creole. The English PDF shows Board approval dated January 15, 2025. The district calendar page is also the place to check for updated versions.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Collier County schools?
faqs.answer: Fall Break runs Monday, November 23 through Friday, November 27, 2026, covering Thanksgiving week. With the weekends on either side, students are off November 21-29. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do Collier County students return to school?
faqs.answer: Winter break is December 21-31, 2026. January 1 is a holiday, and Monday, January 4 is a teacher planning day with no student classes. Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027, as stated on the official calendar.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027, and is March 29 a day off?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 22-29, 2027, including Monday, March 29. Students are also off Friday, March 19 for teacher planning. Including weekends, the continuous break is March 19-29, with classes scheduled to resume Tuesday, March 30.

faqs.question: What are the six early-dismissal dates for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Early dismissal is scheduled for August 26 and October 29, 2026, and February 2, April 21, May 21 and May 27, 2027. Students attend school on these dates but leave early. December 18 ends Quarter 2 and is not listed as an early-dismissal day.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal at Collier County schools?
faqs.answer: The district academic PDF lists early-dismissal dates but does not give one pickup time for every school. Mike Davis Elementary's 2026-2027 schedule lists 11:50 a.m. for early release, and Big Cypress Elementary lists 11:50 a.m. specifically for October 29, 2026. Check your school's dismissal and transportation notices. SACC care-service opening times are not districtwide dismissal times.

faqs.question: Is December 18, 2026 an early-dismissal day?
faqs.answer: No early dismissal is listed for Friday, December 18, 2026. It is the last scheduled student day before winter break and marks the end of Quarter 2. The district calendar does not designate it as a shortened school day. Check your school for any separate dismissal notice.

faqs.question: Which teacher planning and professional development days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on September 21 and October 12, 2026, or January 4 and March 19, 2027. September 21 is teacher professional development; the other three are teacher planning days. These are full no-class days for students, not early-dismissal dates.

faqs.question: Is there school in Collier County on October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12 is a teacher planning day with no classes for students. Combined with the preceding weekend, students have three consecutive days off. Classes resume Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Does the September 11 after-sundown restriction mean school is canceled?
faqs.answer: No daytime school closure or early dismissal is listed for September 11, 2026. The calendar restricts activities after sundown. The same date is also an interim grading-period endpoint for middle and high schools, which does not change the regular daytime class schedule.

faqs.question: Are Collier County schools closed for Labor Day, MLK Day and Presidents Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students and teachers are off for Labor Day on September 7, 2026, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 18, 2027, and Presidents Day on February 15, 2027. Each falls on a Monday, with classes scheduled to resume Tuesday.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday in Collier County in 2026?
faqs.answer: The approved academic calendar does not list Wednesday, November 11, 2026 as a student holiday or an early-dismissal day. Students are scheduled to attend unless the district or their school announces a change.

faqs.question: When do the four grading quarters end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Quarter 1 ends October 9, 2026; Quarter 2 ends December 18, 2026; Quarter 3 ends March 18, 2027; and Quarter 4 ends May 27, 2027. May 27 is also the last student day and has early dismissal. The other three quarter-end dates are not listed for early dismissal.

faqs.question: When do interim grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The interim period-end dates are September 11 and November 6, 2026, and February 5 and April 23, 2027. The September 11 entry is specifically for middle and high schools. The later period-end entries do not carry that restriction on the printed calendar. These dates mark the ends of grading periods, not when interim reports are published.

faqs.question: When are interim grades and progress reports published?
faqs.answer: Interims are published September 17 and November 12, 2026, and February 9 and April 29, 2027. The September 17 publication applies specifically to middle and high schools. Each publication date follows a separate interim period-end date.

faqs.question: When are report cards published in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The scheduled publication dates are October 19, 2026, January 11, April 5 and June 7, 2027. Final report cards are published after the May 27 last student day. June 7 is a reporting date, not an additional school day.

faqs.question: When is high school graduation week in Collier County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar lists graduation week as May 17-21, 2027. This is a ceremony window, not a schedule requiring every graduating senior to attend each day. Individual high schools will provide ceremony times and student checkout instructions. May 21 is also an early-dismissal day.

faqs.question: Is School Age Childcare open on teacher planning days and during spring break?
faqs.answer: The 2026-2027 CCPS School Age Childcare (SACC) calendar lists full-day care on September 21 and October 12, 2026, January 4 and March 19, 2027, and during the March 22-29 spring break. Published full-day hours are 6:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. Confirm enrollment and service availability with your SACC site, especially for weekends. These childcare hours are not regular school hours.

faqs.question: Is SACC open on the April 21, 2027 early-dismissal day?
faqs.answer: No. Students have early dismissal on April 21, 2027, but the separate SACC operating calendar lists childcare programs closed that day. Families using SACC will need another pickup or care arrangement.

faqs.question: Is May 28, 2027 also a school day for students?
faqs.answer: No. The approved academic calendar identifies May 27 as the final student day, with early dismissal. May 28 is a teacher planning day with no regular student classes. The separate SACC calendar lists full-day childcare on May 28, from 6:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m., but also contains conflicting wording about the last day of school. That childcare listing does not change the academic calendar's May 27 end date. Confirm availability with your SACC site.

faqs.question: How many student school days are in the 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The approved academic calendar totals 180 student attendance days. Its four grading quarters contain 42, 44, 51 and 43 student days. The separate 196-day total is for teachers, not students. Early-dismissal dates still count as student attendance days.

faqs.question: Does the calendar include hurricane or weather make-up days?
faqs.answer: The approved academic PDF does not designate specific weather make-up dates or an order for using them. Any actual closure or calendar change should be confirmed through Collier County Public Schools' Weather Updates page and official school or district communications. Do not assume a listed break has been converted to a school day.

faqs.question: Does this school calendar apply to charter schools and childcare programs?
faqs.answer: This page covers the regular Collier County Public Schools academic student calendar. It does not verify separate schedules for charter schools, private schools, School Age Childcare or summer programs. Families should check the relevant school's or program's own calendar before making arrangements.

editorialSummary.heading: School continues after Memorial Day

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page English PDF is byte-for-byte identical to the current official download. The calendar-page HTML links the same PDF. Board approval 2026-01-20 is printed at the top. The full page was extracted and visually inspected; supplementary sources are separately identified for school-specific times and childcare.
about.processing: Read the weekday grids, crossed-out closure cells, diagonal early-dismissal cells and yellow quarter endpoints together with the captions. S and T are cumulative student and teacher totals, not weekend attendance columns. The final student total is explicitly 180; 196 is the teacher total. The quarter counts are 41, 43, 46, 50. Six early dismissals include a graduation-period day and the final student day. December quarter-end is not shortened merely because it is highlighted. Final-day, quarter-end and early-dismissal meanings share one event. Graduation dates remain a ceremony window with no assumed daily participation or senior attendance endpoint. The October 1 after-sundown restriction does not close daytime classes. October 11 and 12, and April 14 and 17, are individual no-class events; combined breaks are derived only where every weekday is verified off. March 20 planning postpones return to derived March 21. May 29 Memorial Day remains inside this year because students finish June 1. September interim endpoints and publication dates are scoped to middle/high schools; later interim entries are not given that restriction. FTE surveys, teacher start, post-student teacher planning and post-year employee holidays are omitted. Final June report cards remain as student reporting milestones without adding attendance. The unexplained semester minute figures are not used to infer school hours. Web calendar repeated rows are deduplicated. No conditional make-up day or unsourced campus-wide dismissal clock is inferred.

about.disclaimer: Graduation windows do not supply ceremony assignments or times. Follow school notices for pickup, transport and senior requirements. SACC hours are care-service hours and must not be treated as the regular school timetable. The district may announce later weather-related changes through official channels.

faqs.question: When does the 2027-2028 school year start and end in Collier County?
faqs.answer: Students start Wednesday, August 11, 2027, and finish Thursday, June 1, 2028. The last student day has early dismissal. June 2 is a teacher planning day after regular student classes have ended.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Collier County school calendar for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The Collier County Public Schools Academic & District Calendars page provides the approved 2027-2028 PDF under future calendars, with English, Spanish and Creole versions. The English calendar shows Board approval dated January 20, 2026. Check the district calendar page for later revisions.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district's Fall Break is November 22-26, 2027, covering Thanksgiving week. Including the surrounding weekends, students have November 20-28 off. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in January 2028?
faqs.answer: Winter break runs December 20-31, 2027. Monday, January 3, 2028 is a paid holiday with no school for students or teachers, and January 4 is a teacher planning day without students. Classes resume Wednesday, January 5.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2028, and why do students return March 21?
faqs.answer: The official spring break is March 13-17, 2028. The weekend follows, and Monday, March 20 is a teacher planning day with no student classes. Students therefore have March 11-20 off continuously, with classes scheduled to resume Tuesday, March 21.

faqs.question: Are Collier County students off on October 11 and 12, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, October 11 is a no-school day for students and teachers, and Tuesday, October 12 is a teacher planning day without students. Including the preceding weekend, students have October 9-12 off. Classes are scheduled to resume Wednesday, October 13. The calendar lists these as separate events, not as the November Fall Break.

faqs.question: Is there school on April 14 and April 17, 2028?
faqs.answer: No. Both Friday, April 14 and Monday, April 17 are marked as no-school days for students and teachers. Together with the weekend, they create a four-day student break from April 14 through April 17. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, April 18. The academic PDF does not give these two dates specific holiday names.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays have no school for students in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on September 22 and October 12, 2027, or January 4 and March 20, 2028. September 22 is teacher professional development; the other three dates are teacher planning days. These are full no-class days for students, not early-dismissal dates.

faqs.question: Does the October 1 after-sundown restriction cancel school?
faqs.answer: The calendar does not mark October 1, 2027 as a daytime school holiday or early-dismissal day. It states that no CCPS events may take place after sundown. Families with evening activities should check their school's notices. The annual PDF does not specify a sunset clock time.

faqs.question: What are the six early-dismissal dates for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Early dismissal is scheduled for August 25 and November 4, 2027, and February 1, March 29, May 26 and June 1, 2028. Students attend school on these dates but leave early. June 1 is also the final student day. December 17, 2027 ends Quarter 2 but is not listed for early dismissal.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal at Collier County schools in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The district's approved academic calendar gives early-dismissal dates but does not specify a single districtwide pickup time. Check your school's 2027-2028 bell schedule, early-release notices and transportation information. School-specific times or childcare hours published for 2026-2027 should not be assumed to apply to this later year.

faqs.question: Is December 17, 2027 an early-dismissal day?
faqs.answer: December 17, 2027 marks the end of Quarter 2 and is the final scheduled student day before winter break. The approved calendar does not mark it as an early-dismissal day. Winter break begins December 20, and students return January 5, 2028.

faqs.question: Do Collier County students still have school after Memorial Day in 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. Memorial Day is Monday, May 29, 2028, with no school for students or teachers. Students are scheduled to attend May 30 and May 31, followed by the early-dismissal last student day on Thursday, June 1. High school commencement ceremonies the previous week do not end the districtwide student calendar.

faqs.question: Which major Monday holidays give students long weekends?
faqs.answer: Labor Day on September 6, 2027, Martin Luther King Jr. Day on January 17, 2028, and Presidents Day on February 21, 2028 are student and teacher holidays. Classes are scheduled to resume the following Tuesday after each. Memorial Day on May 29 is also a Monday holiday, but it falls just before the June 1 last student day.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday in Collier County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar does not list November 11, 2027 as a student holiday or early-dismissal date. Instead, that date is listed for interim report publication. Students are scheduled to attend unless CCPS announces a change.

faqs.question: When do the four grading quarters end in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Quarter 1 ends October 8, 2027; Quarter 2 ends December 17, 2027; Quarter 3 ends March 10, 2028; and Quarter 4 ends June 1, 2028. June 1 is also the last student day and has early dismissal. The other three quarter-end dates are not listed for early dismissal.

faqs.question: When do interim grading periods end in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The period-end dates are September 10 and November 5, 2027, and February 4 and April 21, 2028. The September 10 entry specifically applies to middle and high schools. The later entries do not carry that restriction in the official PDF. These dates are separate from interim publication dates.

faqs.question: When are interim grades and progress reports published in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Interims are published September 16 and November 11, 2027, and February 10 and April 27, 2028. The September 16 publication is specifically marked for middle and high schools. The later publications are not given that same restriction on the official calendar.

faqs.question: When are report cards available in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 18, 2027, and January 12 and March 27, 2028. Final report cards are available electronically June 12, 2028. That final reporting date follows the June 1 last student day and does not extend the school year.

faqs.question: When are Collier County high school graduation ceremonies in 2028?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar gives May 24-26, 2028 as the high school commencement window. Each high school will provide its ceremony date, time and student instructions. May 26 is also a district student early-dismissal day. The commencement window does not establish a separate last attendance date for every senior.

faqs.question: How many student school days are scheduled in 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The approved calendar includes 180 student attendance days. The four quarters contain 41, 43, 46 and 50 days, totaling 180. The separately printed 196-day figure is for teachers. Early-dismissal days still count as student attendance days.

faqs.question: Where can I check SACC childcare hours for 2027-2028?
faqs.answer: The regular academic calendar does not specify SACC childcare dates or hours. Check the Collier County Public Schools School Age Childcare page and your child's participating site for the 2027-2028 operating calendar, enrollment information and service hours. The 2026-2027 SACC schedule should not be used to assume availability for 2027-2028.

faqs.question: Are hurricane or weather make-up dates included in the 2027-2028 calendar?
faqs.answer: The approved PDF does not designate specific weather make-up dates or an order for using them. Check the district's Weather Updates page and school announcements for any later closure, rescheduling or calendar revision. No listed holiday should be treated as an activated make-up day without an official announcement.

faqs.question: Does this calendar cover charter schools, private schools and after-school programs?
faqs.answer: This page follows the regular Collier County Public Schools academic student calendar. Separate charter-school, private-school, childcare and summer-program schedules are not verified here. Families should use the relevant school's or program's own calendar when arranging attendance or care.
